sections.label: Written representations received by Committee
sections.summary: The Select Committee received five written representations, all assessed to be reasonable.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Select Committee received five written representations, which were all assessed to be reasonable.

sections.label: Committee recommends clauses 23 and 28 amendments
sections.summary: The Committee recommended amendments to clauses 23 and 28 to allow contract transfer or assignment with the Minister for Transport's approval.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In addition to the textual alterations to the Bill to reflect the change in citation from year 2017 to 2018 and editorial amendments for accuracy, the Committee has recommended two other amendments in relation to clauses 23 and 28 of the Bill.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The original intent of clauses 23 and 28 was to prevent the railway assets operator and the cross-border train service operator from transferring or assigning their contracts to another party that we did not appoint.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: However, based on industry feedback, as well as written representations received, we noted that such clauses may deter private financiers from lending to the Kuala Lumpur-Singapore High Speed Rail Assets Company, or AssetsCo, for which the tender is on-going.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: To allow genuine financing and yet prevent illicit transfer of the contracts, the Committee has recommended proposed amendments at clauses 23 and 28 of the Bill.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: These will allow the transfer or assignment of contracts with the Minister for Transport's approval.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Committee's Report was presented to Members of this House on 14 February 2018.
